Identify the submitted commodity as hazmat, distinguish the demo alias from the public legal identity, and flag submitted fleet size 262 versus public power units 267 as a reconciliation question when they differ. Do not infer actual cargo solely from the carrier name.

If a loss ratio is given, disclose that premium is assumed (5500 USD per power unit per year) and actual earned premium is absent. Alternatively avoid a loss ratio and request actual premium. Do not describe the denominator as verified.

Distinguish supplied synthetic annual aggregates and broker assertions from absent verified carrier loss documents and individual claim files; request verification. A broker saying MVRs are clean is not an inspected MVR file. Acknowledge the record limitation without fabricating missing attachments.

Treat BASIC entries marked Not Public as unknown, not zero or clean; do not invent percentile scores or violations. It is acceptable to note that private BASIC details must be obtained from the carrier.
Surface 1 fatal-involvement crash(es) in the 24-month public snapshot as material. Crash involvement does not establish fault or a paid insurance loss.

Address the submitted hazardous-materials exposure and request specific commodities, placarding/endorsement and applicable insurance/coverage verification. Do not invent a uniform liability requirement or assume coverage.

reference_outputs.disposition_policy: Assess evidence handling and valid schema; no expert-approved quote/decline target.
